summary: Iteration-6: verified bulk_save endpoint + no-PDF WA flow + Products page mitra-grouping/search/bulk dialog. Backend: 44/44 pytest passing (added 7 new tests in test_bulk_save.py for bulk_save: create, update-preserves-last_reset_date, empty-menu skip, mixed create/update, 404 on bad mitra, 401 auth guard, list-after-bulk-save). Frontend: send-wa button confirmed opens ONLY wa.me URL (no PDF download); WA message contains 3 required summary lines with exact wording. Products page grouped by mitra (12 groups), search filters by menu/mitra/cabang, clear button works, bulk dialog with add/remove row and pre-filled existing products verified. Both edit-mitra-products-{id} and edit-product-{id} open bulk dialog with rows pre-filled.

issues: DialogDescription still says 'Klik Kirim pada masing-masing mitra untuk mengunduh PDF laporan & membuka WhatsApp mitra. Lampirkan PDF yang terunduh saat mengirim di WhatsApp.' — stale copy since new flow no longer downloads PDF. Update text to reflect WA-only send.
Recharts still logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on initial render (cosmetic).

action_items: Update blast modal DialogDescription in /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx (L252) to remove the 'mengunduh PDF laporan & Lampirkan PDF yang terunduh' text — the new send flow only opens wa.me with a text summary.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/products/bulk_save correctly separates create vs update by presence of item.id; last_reset_date preserved on updates (only $set of denorm+editable fields) and set to today_str() on create — verified via test_bulk_save_update_preserves_last_reset_date. ✓
Empty/whitespace menu items filtered on backend AND frontend (Products.jsx L164 filter r.menu.length>0). ✓

bulk_save returns {ok, count, products} where products is the full re-queried list for the mitra sorted by menu — good for UI refresh, though frontend still calls load() after which is a duplicate GET. Minor optimization opportunity, not a bug.
buildMitraReportMessage(mitraCard) computes totalTidakTerjual = sum(max(stok-jumlah_terjual, 0)) across items — correct semantics for '# not sold today'. Format matches spec exactly. ✓
sendReportToMitra no longer calls exportMitraPDF — only window.open(waLink). Verified via monkey-patched window.open: 1 URL captured (wa.me), 0 blob URLs, 0 download events. ✓
Products.jsx grouping by mitra_id (Map with mitra_id key) sorts by cabang_name then mitra_name — matches spec of showing 'mitra_name · cabang_name · (n produk)'. ✓
Search filter is case-insensitive across menu/mitra_name/cabang_name fields. ✓
Bulk dialog: row key uses random _key for new rows and p.id for existing; correctly resets rows when cabang/mitra changes; save uses api.post('/products/bulk_save', ...) with cleaned items. ✓
Backend bulk_save loop is not wrapped in a MongoDB session/transaction — a mid-loop failure could leave partial writes. Acceptable for MVP but flag for future hardening.
(carry-over) CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is spec-invalid — set explicit origins for prod.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — WA send opens only wa.me, no PDF; Products search + mitra grouping + bulk dialog all working; add-row/remove-row/edit-mitra-products/edit-product all wire into single bulk dialog
